_comment: Fixed, versioned corpus for the scale ladder and instrument suite (loop-v2.md §3.F, §4). Each entry pins url+sha so numbers are comparable across engine versions. `lang` is the grammar id from plugins/grain/engine/grammars/manifest.json. `axes` names the idiom/shape this repo was chosen to exercise (see docs at bottom of file). `size` is measured directly in the clone this entry was pinned from (`git rev-list --count HEAD` / `git ls-files | wc -l`); for a shallow/partial clone, `size.commits` reflects what is ACTUALLY present locally (not the upstream repo's true history) and `upstreamCommits` records the full repo's real depth for comparison — the gap between the two is itself the thing the shallow/partial entries exist to measure. `bucket` is the scale-ladder rung this entry represents (§3.F: ~1k / ~10k / ~100k commits); shallow/partial entries are bucketed 'boundary' because their local history does not represent their nominal scale. To run: point run-corpus.mjs --ladder --corpus-dir at a directory containing one subdirectory per `id` (a real clone checked out at, or reachable to, `sha`).
_grammarCoverageNote: manifest.json ships 23 grammars today: the 19 code languages this corpus's `lang` field targets (typescript, tsx, javascript, python, go, java, c_sharp, ruby, rust, php, c, cpp, kotlin, scala, bash, lua, zig, groovy, solidity) plus 4 config-file formats (json, yaml, toml, properties) added since this corpus was first pinned. The 4 config grammars are not given dedicated axis entries — they are ubiquitous incidentally (package.json/composer.json, Cargo.toml in axum-full/serde-full, .yml in symfony-*/nest, application.properties in spring-petclinic/okhttp) rather than each repo's reason for being chosen; instrument B (declaration coverage) is what should be pointed at them specifically if that incidental coverage is ever in doubt. Six of the 19 code languages had no prior field evidence anywhere before this corpus: kotlin, lua, zig, bash, groovy, tsx.

repos.note: Google's LevelDB. .cc/.h C++, not pure C (a prior scratchpad clone named 'leveldb-test' is actually this — mislabeled, corrected here). Class declarations live in .h headers, but EXT2GRAMMAR (plugins/grain/engine/config.mjs) routes .h to the C grammar unconditionally, even in an all-C++ repo — worth an instrument-B declaration-coverage check on this repo specifically: are the class types declared in db/*.h even seen?
